name: amp
title: Amp
description: Create and track Amp threads; threads run in Orbs by default
author: NathanFlurry

commands.name: new-thread
commands.title: New Thread
commands.description: Create an Amp thread; it runs in an Orb by default

commands.name: capture-window
commands.title: Capture Window and Start Thread
commands.description: Capture the frontmost window and open the new thread form

commands.name: thread-status
commands.title: Amp Thread Status
commands.description: Track all current Amp thread status from the menu bar

commands.name: thread-overview
commands.title: Amp Threads
commands.subtitle: Amp
commands.description: Open your Amp threads; running and unread counts appear in root search

preferences.name: ampPath
preferences.title: Amp Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to Amp. Leave blank to auto-detect it.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal Application
preferences.description: Application used by Open in Terminal actions. Defaults to the system handler for .command files (Terminal).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
